Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

additional_info.subject: ID0413932-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R8 170002537] Screen black CRM:00642002171
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
As per the issue reported by the end customer, the screen is black. The clamp in the attached picture flashes red (as seen in the trailing email). It seems that a colleague pressed the small button, which caused the screen to come back on.
Disconnected the red cable of screen alimentation and restarted FC14 and reconnected the cable.
Kindly perform the following steps onsite to resolve the issue:
1.Please reboot the charger.
2.You will need to change the DP cable. Please replace the DP cable with a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part and NOT any other DP cable). Also please route the DP cable as far as possible from routers
and avoid any loop on the cable,
R&D found out that this component is affecting the EMC performance.
3.Also please check the 24VDC power supply. it should be set to 25VDC.
Please find below attached knowledge article link for your reference.
